inputs.text: More than 58 lakh names have been removed, but the tribunals meant to hear challenges still aren’t operating. The Supreme Court has issued its direction, the appeal software is supposedly ready, and yet the state and Calcutta High Court are still discussing locations. It looks like a convenient way to keep the remedy on paper while people remain trapped outside the system. The delay seems managed rather than accidental: the process can be presented as fair while affected voters are denied any real chance to challenge what happened.
